transcript.text: Hello ji relationship ko leke kuch puchna tha mujhe

Bahut thak gayi hu
Kuch samajh nhi aa rha kya karu
Main bilkul samajh rahi hoon ji. Saturday ko "Om Sham Shanicharaya Namah" 108 baar japein, yeh aapko rahat dega.
Theek hai try kar lungi par mann nhi lagta kisi cheez me

Hmm dekhti hu
 
Thanku ji batane ke liye
Bahot shukriya ji. Apna khayal rakhiyega.
Ok ji tc 🙏
Jaane se pehle ek baat aur. 2026 ke baad bada yog shuru hoga.
Achha thik hai dekhte hai
Gn 🙏
Good night ji, thoda aaram karein.
